target_customer: Healthcare providers and digital health developers building HIPAA compliant, FHIR native apps
problem: Medical apps are hard to build and maintain because of compliance, interoperability and stakeholder complexity. Medplum offers an open source, API first EHR toolkit.
business_model: Open source core with paid hosted and enterprise offerings, support and services
product_category: Open source headless EHR and FHIR developer platform

founders.name: Reshma Khilnani
education: MIT, BS and MEng in EECS

founders.name: Rahul Agarwal
founders.background_notes: Signs the YC launch post and is listed as COO on the company about page. Background not found.

technical_complexity.rationale: A FHIR native data layer with HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance, authentication, workflows and an app toolkit is large and compliance heavy, though the founders had built healthcare integrations at MedXT and One Medical.

defensibility.rationale: Open source lowers lock in and invites forks, but compliance certifications, deep integrations and an ecosystem of apps built on the platform raise switching costs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied or acquired Medplum in sources found. Later sources list headless EHR rivals such as Oystehr and Canvas, which are not dated to the batch.

market_need_then: The Launch HN post argues that building medical apps is hard and cites open source successes such as GitLab, PostHog and Airbyte as inspiration. No quantified demand data was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses medplum.com per the YC page.

identity.logo: Brand page lets the logo be used in color, black or white and says not to alter it. Primary color is a plum shade, matching the name.
identity.visual_style: Open Color palette with plum primary

branding.brand_signature: Plum color tied to the name
branding.community_and_virality: Active Discord community and open source contributors; the May 2026 monthly update reports 100+ commits from 20+ contributors.

brand_strength.rationale: A distinctive name with a matching plum color, an official brand page, trademark registration in October 2023 and an active Discord and GitHub community. No press about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Medplum is active and shipping, with a HITRUST certification announced in June 2026, partner integrations and a large open source contributor base. Repeat founders from MedXT combined healthcare engineering experience with an open source distribution strategy. Funding history could not be verified, so it is unclear how much it has raised or whether it has grown beyond a small team.
notes: No round is recorded because every funding figure comes from aggregators only: Caplight 550K total, CB Insights 6.5M over five rounds including a 3M seed dated 2024-11-15, Extruct 125K, others 130K, and investor names such as Health Engine, 10X Capital, Brighter Capital, Gaingels, Page One Ventures and Pioneer Fund. They conflict and no company post, press release or filing was found. A Caplight banner mentioning a 16M Series A belongs to an unrelated company. Competitors left empty: the YC page names none and search found only 2026 comparison articles. Corporate name Orangebot, Inc. per the site footer. Name origin not found. No outcome news (acquisition, layoffs) found.
